title: Improved Vacuum Gripping of Rough Surfaces

features.item: A housing with a grip portion for gripping and an electrically operated vacuum generating device
features.quote: The vacuum gripper 10 preferably includes a lightweight, portable pump 30 with an on-board power source (renewable or not) and a controller, as schematically illustrated in FIG. 8 .
features.note: The reference describes a portable pump with a controller, which implies an electrically operated vacuum generating device, and the overall device is a vacuum gripper, which would have a grip portion.
features.refuted: The quote describes a pump with power source and controller, but does not mention a housing with a grip portion for gripping.

features.item: The grip portion is a hollow body
features.note: The reference does not explicitly describe the grip portion as a hollow body. While it mentions exhaust air being guided, it doesn't specify the grip's internal structure.

features.item: Exhaust air from the vacuum generating device is guided through the grip portion to an air outlet
features.note: The reference describes a vacuum port for evacuation but does not detail the path of exhaust air from the vacuum generating device, nor does it mention guiding it through a grip portion to an air outlet.

features.item: A sound-damping device is arranged in the grip portion
features.note: The reference does not mention any sound-damping device arranged in the grip portion.

features.item: A grip unit with hollow grip portion, electrically operated vacuum generator, exhaust air routed through grip to outlet, and sound-damping device in grip portion
features.quote: The vacuum gripper 10 preferably includes a lightweight, portable pump 30 with an on-board power source (renewable or not) and a controller, as schematically illustrated in FIG. 8 .
features.note: The reference discloses an electrically operated vacuum generator (portable pump) as part of a vacuum gripper, which would have a grip unit. However, it does not disclose the grip portion being hollow, exhaust air routed through the grip to an outlet, or a sound-damping device in the grip portion.

features.item: A vacuum handling apparatus comprising a suction plate with carrier plate and seal, and a grip unit with hollow grip portion, electrically operated vacuum generator, exhaust air routed through grip to outlet, and sound-damping device
features.quote: The vacuum gripper 10 is composed of a vacuum plate 12 , having a vacuum port 14 therethrough, and a crushable open-pore wall 15 adhered to the plate 12 around a periphery thereof, to enclose an interior of a cup.
features.note: The reference discloses a vacuum gripper with a vacuum plate and a seal (crushable open-pore wall) and an electrically operated vacuum generator (portable pump). However, it does not disclose the grip portion being hollow, exhaust air routed through the grip to an outlet, or a sound-damping device in the grip portion.

features.item: The grip portion is at least partially lined with sound-damping material
features.note: The reference does not mention any sound-damping material lining the grip portion.

features.item: The vacuum generating device is arranged completely in a first housing portion
features.note: The reference describes a portable pump but does not specify its arrangement within a multi-part housing or a 'first housing portion'.

features.item: A sound-reducing device is arranged in the first housing portion or the first housing portion is lined with sound-reducing material
features.note: The reference does not mention any sound-reducing device or material in any housing portion.

features.item: The grip portion is elongated between the first housing portion and a second housing portion, with air outlet on the second housing portion
features.note: The reference does not describe a grip portion elongated between two housing portions with an air outlet on the second portion.

features.item: An air collection screw arranged upstream of the grip portion in the first housing portion for collecting exhaust air
features.note: The reference does not mention an air collection screw or any specific mechanism for collecting exhaust air upstream of a grip portion.

features.item: Bent or curved air baffles downstream of the grip portion for guiding exhaust air to the air outlet
features.note: The reference does not mention bent or curved air baffles for guiding exhaust air.

features.item: A battery coupling point on the second housing portion with air baffles directing exhaust air away from the battery coupling point
features.note: The reference mentions an on-board power source (batteries) but does not describe a 'second housing portion', a battery coupling point, or air baffles directing exhaust air away from it.

features.item: The grip unit and suction plate are releasably connected via a coupling device
features.note: The reference describes a vacuum plate and a crushable wall adhered to it, but does not explicitly state that the grip unit and suction plate are releasably connected via a coupling device.

features.item: The grip unit has a suction opening fluidically connected to a suction chamber delimited by the suction plate
features.quote: The vacuum gripper 10 is composed of a vacuum plate 12 , having a vacuum port 14 therethrough, and a crushable open-pore wall 15 adhered to the plate 12 around a periphery thereof, to enclose an interior of a cup.
features.note: The vacuum port 14 on the vacuum plate 12 serves as the suction opening, which is fluidically connected to the interior of the cup (suction chamber) delimited by the plate and wall.

claims.note: This reference describes vacuum grippers and kits for sealing them, but does not describe a 'grip unit for a vacuum hand-operated laying device' or its specific components like a 'suction plate'.

claims.quote: The vacuum gripper 10 preferably includes a lightweight, portable pump 30 with an on-board power source (renewable or not) and a controller, as schematically illustrated in FIG. 8 .
claims.note: The reference discloses an electrically operated vacuum generating device (pump) and a housing (vacuum gripper), but does not explicitly describe a 'grip portion for gripping the grip unit' in the context of a hand-operated device.
The reference does not describe a grip portion designed as a hollow body.
The reference does not describe exhaust air being guided through a grip portion to an air outlet, nor a sound-damping device in the grip portion.
The reference does not mention a sound-damping device arranged in a grip portion.
The reference does not mention a grip portion being lined with a sound-damping material.
The reference does not describe a vacuum generating device arranged completely in a first housing portion.
The reference does not mention a sound-reducing device in a housing portion or a housing portion lined with sound-reducing material.
This reference does not disclose a grip portion elongated between a first and second housing portion, nor an air outlet arranged on a second housing portion.
This reference does not disclose an air collection device in the form of an air collection screw, nor its arrangement upstream of a grip portion in a first housing portion.
This reference does not disclose bent or curved air baffles arranged downstream of a grip portion for guiding exhaust air to an air outlet.

claims.quote: The suction cup may be coupled to a pump with a portable power supply, a mechanical grip, a controller, and a sensor to define an autonomous system for maintaining attachment of a body to a rough wall of a structure
claims.note: This passage discloses a portable power supply for a pump, which could be a battery, but does not specify a battery coupling point on a housing or air baffles for directing exhaust air away from it.
The reference does not mention air baffles for directing exhaust air away from a battery coupling point.

claims.quote: The present invention relates in general to vacuum gripping of rough surfaces, and in particular to a kit, apparatus and method, for utilizing an unctuous material to improve adhesion of known suction cups fora longer time with less suction power,
claims.note: The reference discloses a vacuum gripping apparatus.
claims.refuted: The quote describes the invention's general purpose and scope, not the structural claim of 'comprising' a vacuum handling apparatus.

claims.quote: The vacuum gripper 10 is composed of a vacuum plate 12 , having a vacuum port 14 therethrough, and a crushable open-pore wall 15 adhered to the plate 12 around a periphery thereof, to enclose an interior of a cup.
claims.note: The reference discloses a vacuum plate (carrier plate) and a seal (crushable open-pore wall) fastened to the plate and extending around its periphery. However, it does not explicitly state that the seal is 'fastened to the carrier plate and extends around the carrier plate' in the exact phrasing, but rather 'adhered to the plate 12 around a periphery thereof'.

The reference does not contain a 'grip unit according to claim 1' as it is a prior art reference being charted against a subject invention, and claim 1 refers to the subject invention's claim 1, not the reference's claim 1.
This reference does not describe a coupling device for releasably connecting a grip unit and a suction plate.

claims.quote: The vacuum gripper 10 is composed of a vacuum plate 12 , having a vacuum port 14 therethrough, and a crushable open-pore wall 15 adhered to the plate 12 around a periphery thereof, to enclose an interior of a cup.
claims.note: The reference describes a vacuum plate with a vacuum port that encloses an interior of a cup, which functions as a suction chamber to generate a vacuum.

overall.why: The reference describes a vacuum gripper with an electrically operated vacuum generator and a suction plate, which aligns with some aspects of the subject invention. However, it lacks specific details regarding the grip portion's internal structure, exhaust air routing, and sound-damping features.
